task: OEIS A385403 - min triples covering {1..n} forcing a mono triple under every 2-coloring (non-2-colorable covering 3-graphs)
model: CP-SAT: s_t binary for each 3-subset t; sum s_t = k; coverage per vertex; hitting constraint sum_{t mono under c} s_t >= 1 for every 2-coloring c (full 2^n for n<=13, halved 2^(n-1) with vertex 1 fixed red for n>=14 - exact by complement symmetry). a(n) = min feasible k, settled by INFEASIBLE at k-1 + FEASIBLE at k.

results.how: proved (INFEASIBLE at value-1 + FEASIBLE at value)
proved (INFEASIBLE at value-1 + FEASIBLE at value)
